posts.title: How to get 1TB free egress for Amazon S3 via CloudFront
posts.description: S3 offers free egress bandwidth of 100GB per month, while CloudFront pay-as-you-go has 1TB for free. This creates an incentive to add a CloudFront distribution and route read traffic to the bucket via that. posts.title: Backups with Restic: 2-year retrospective
posts.description: Around 2 years ago I started looking into how I could back up my laptop and my phone. I went with Restic and multiple backends for storage and I'm fairly happy with the result, even though I overengineered it a bit.
